verdict.rationale: Pika's own marketing claims a customizable character that can be reused across creations (pika-docs-6), plus 30-second multi-shot generation and reference-driven videos (pika-docs-1, pika-docs-9, pika-docs-19). That points to cross-shot character persistence, but every source is a one-line vendor claim with no detail on how consistency is maintained. Missing for 10: documented scene/environment consistency across shots, detail on how reusable characters hold identity between generations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
